# PT Metropole Trikarya Ciptaperkasa (MTC)
> Exclusive authorized distributor for Chichibu Japan and Tuffloor in Indonesia since 1997. Verified supplier for Jakarta MRT Phase 1 & 2.

## Key Product Specifications (Mohs 8)
- **Chichibu Dry Shake Hardener**: Premium Japanese-standard powder hardener achieving **Mohs hardness 8**. Features non-metallic aggregates for extreme abrasion resistance.
- **Chichibu Multi-Hardener (Liquid)**: High-performance penetrating liquid hardener. Chemically reacts to harden concrete surfaces to a verified **Mohs hardness 8** rating.
- **Tuffloor**: Industrial-grade dry shake solution for high-traffic warehouses and factories.
